long_biography.plain_text:
Michel Reybier began in retail, managing a supermarket group before moving into chocolate, biscuits and branded charcuterie. The meat-products company behind Aoste, Justin Bridou and Cochonou became his principal wealth engine. He sold that business in 1996, converting operating equity into capital for a new investment phase. He subsequently acquired vineyards and built the La Réserve hospitality brand, extending his activity into hotels, restaurants and wellness.

Reybier now chairs or owns wine and hospitality companies and is a major shareholder of AEVIS VICTORIA. The listed investment company spans healthcare, hospitality and infrastructure, while his separate portfolio includes Bordeaux, Champagne and Provence wine interests. This makes hospitality the clearest current operating focus and founder the strongest description of his relationship to the businesses. AEVIS shareholder-group percentages, hotel revenues, clinic assets, wine-estate values and investment-vehicle balances belong to companies or co-investors; none alone establishes his personal net worth.
